Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SCISSORS, STAPEDECTOMY, CROCODILE JAW 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for stapedectomy crocodile jaw scissors used in 
ENT microsurgery* 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown In Fig. 1. 





ENLARGED DETAIL AT A

*5ee IS : 3642-1978 ' General requirements for surgical instruments ( first revision ) \ 

All dimensions In millimetres. 
FIG. 1 SCISSORS STAPEDECTOMY, CROCODILE JAW 

2.1 The tolerance on various dimensions shall be permitted as given below: 

±0'05 mm on dimensions up to 5 mm; and 

±0'1 mm on dimensions above 5 mm and up to 10 mm 

2.2 Joint — As specified in 6 of IS : 3642-1978. The joint shall be revetted. 

2.3 Finger Loops — Finger loops shall conform to size 1 of 12.1 of IS : 3642-1978. 

3. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Cr13 of IS : 6602-1972 ' Specification 
for stainless steel bars and flats \ 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The scissors shall be free from cracks, seams, burrs, flaws and other defects. 



Adopted 29 May 1980 



August 1980, ISI 



INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION 

MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR HARG 
NEW OELHI 110002 



IS: 9526 -1980 

4.2 The blades shall close fully and freely with a continuous pinch, without stiffness and excessive 
cross-over action. There shall be no play at the joint. 

4.3 The edges shall be even and rounded except the cutting edge which shall be sharp. 

4.4 The cutting edge shall not have any feathers, nicks or burrs when viewed under a magnification 
of 10 X. 

4.5 The scissors shall be matt finished and passivated. 

5. Heat Treatment — The scissors shall be hardened and tempered to a hardness of 450 to 550 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Performance — The whole length of the cutting edges including the tips shall cut wet tissue 
paper, teased out cotton wool and fine hair accurately and cleanly, when worked with either right or 
left hand. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance — The scissors shall satisfy the boiling and autoclaving test as specified 
in IS: 7531-1975 ( Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless 
steel surgical instruments 1 , 

7. Marking — Each pair of scissors shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's 
name, initials or recognised trade-mark. 

7.1 IS/ Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — Shall be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. The working 
ends shall be suitably protected.
